Closes drift loop: every cedar_fragments[] entry in contracts/*.openapi.yaml + bounded-contexts.json must appear here; every Cedar file on disk must appear here. Validator (planned: lean-a-cedar-fragment-coverage) flags orphan fragments + missing referenced fragments.

fragments.purpose_short: Foundational Cedar fragment gating all ops.oyatie.com routes for principals with role=internal-employee. Inherited from Foundry M02-P20 substrate; ops simply imports + composes.
fragments.blocking_reason: M02-P20 substrate not yet landed in HEAD (parallel session); ops cannot author this fragment standalone — must consume Foundry's canonical version to avoid divergent policy.

fragments.purpose_short: Wave 5 tenant-private gate for workspace shell — restricts certain surfaces (e.g., per-tenant dashboards mounted under /workspace) to principals with matching tenant_id claim.
Wave 5 internal-sre gate for state-mutation routes (e.g., POST /workspace/docs/api/v1/extractors/{id}/refresh, surface state flips).
Wave 5 admin-only gate for the full surface catalog endpoint (GET /workspace/api/v1/surfaces).
Wave 5 tenant-public gate for docs manifest read — allows any authenticated principal of a tenant to read that tenant's manifest snapshot.
Wave 5 row-level filter enforcing principal.tenant_id == manifest_row.tenant_scope for every record returned from GET /workspace/docs/manifest.
Wave 5 SSE event scope filter enforcing principal.tenant_id == event.tenant_scope on every emitted LiveFeedEvent.

drift_invariants.rule: Every cedar_fragments[] reference in contracts/*.openapi.yaml MUST appear as a fragment_id in this registry.
Every cedar_fragments_planned[] reference in /registry/bounded-contexts.json MUST appear as a fragment_id in this registry.
Every .cedar file under .omc/cedar/ MUST appear as a fragment_id with status=operational; orphans fail the lane.
Fragment status=operational REQUIRES fragment_path_planned to exist in HEAD; status=planned/blocked-by-foundation-prerequisite REQUIRES path to NOT exist in HEAD (consistency).
